services.name: RV Park Cedar City UT
services.desc: When you rent a RV site/lot from Indian Peaks RV Park: CHECK OUT IS AT 11:00AM ON THE DATE OF YOUR DEPARTURE. Your rented lot/site may be accessed at any time by park manager and/or representatives of Indian Peaks RV Park. You will be told to leave if ANY of the following rules are violated WITHOUT rents returned. You do not have the right to enter another guest's lot/site without their permission first. Any Public disturbances are not allowed. Quiet hours start from 9:00 pm - 9:00 am, if you are a disturbance you will be told to leave in the morning. Only Amber Colored exterior lighting will be permitted PERIOD. ALL Non-Amber Lighting MUST be turned off at Indian Peaks RV Park. Speed limit
